title: Reload the gun in a quiet lull instead of running it dry in the next exchange (LULL_RELOAD_ON)
behaviors: with an enemy mech as target, send reload when the gun holds fewer than half a magazine, is not reloading, and for at least 1 s we have not fired it, the target has had no clear line, and no visible enemy has line of sight to us; t >= 10 s and no drop listed
next_action: Grok: assign or park. If built: one flag LULL_RELOAD_ON default false (+LULL_RELOAD_QUIET_S 1), base-0 hazard with fired/diff/score and the clear-target-while-reloading count.
single_decision: Extend the champion's existing early reload (brain.ts:1071 reloads at < half a magazine when no enemy is known) to the 'enemy known but no line either way for 1 s' lull. Movement, aim and fire are unchanged.
trigger: target is an enemy mech (not a farm shot) AND !target.clear AND gun ammo < mag/2 AND gun reload == 0 AND the gun is not set to fire this tick AND no threat has seenAt(cone=false) LOS to us AND the last tick with gun fire, a clear target or LOS on us is >= LULL_RELOAD_QUIET_S (1 s) ago AND obs.t >= 10 AND obs.drops.length === 0
hook: brain.ts act(), target branch: next to the forced reload at brain.ts:1052 (`if (gun >= 0 && (w(gun).ammo ?? 1) === 0 && (w(gun).reload ?? 0) <= 0) act.reload = true`), after the fire decisions at brain.ts:1024-1027. One closure variable next to standoffId (brain.ts:310) holds the last contact time. Compare the no-target branch brain.ts:1070-1071. Flag + LULL_RELOAD_QUIET_S in params.ts.
gates: Cannot start before t = 10 s (explicit obs.t >= 10). Never starts while any supply drop is listed in obs.drops (called and not yet taken; protocol.md:359 every mech sees it from the moment it is called), so it never runs while a drop is announced/active and can never displace drop run/hold (those need a listed drop). Off = champion exactly (flag false short-circuits). No movement change at all.

evidence.sim_forced_reloads: Champion auto-reloads at 0 ammo with an enemy target 791 times in 181/192 games; the gun is reloading while a clear enemy target is present for 27,562 decisions (~2,756 s) in 190/192 games.
evidence.sim_trigger_state: Spec trigger (1 s quiet): 52 reload starts in 31/192 games. All lull decisions without the quiet gate (1,657 in 70/192 games): ammo median 3 of 12 (p10 1, p90 5), target distance median 70 m (p10 42, p90 163), alive median 15, t median 35.0 s (p10 15.2, p90 58.6).
evidence.sim_tradeoff: Of the 52 starts, a clear target came back inside the 2.4 s reload in 27 (52%) - the cost case - and the champion later had a forced reload at 0 ammo with a clear target within 10 s in 21 (40%) - the case P34 removes. Without the 1 s quiet gate: 143 starts in 67 games but 76% see a clear target within 2.4 s, which is why the gate is in the spec; with 2 s quiet: 32 starts in 20 games, 41% / 34%.
evidence.protocol: Gun: mag 12 at 0.24 s (2.88 s of fire), reload 2.4 s, early reload allowed (protocol.md:303, :231); the sim models it (tools/sim/engine.ts:349).
evidence.showdown_first_fights: PR #145 coord/research-doug-1941.md: first hit decides first fights (KILL/DIED 309/171 when ours vs 129/297); median first-fight duration 4.5-4.8 s, longer than one magazine, so a fight entered with ~3 rounds contains a 2.4 s reload.
evidence.watcher: No reload metric in coord/data/watcher (not measured).

estimated_activation: ~31/192 games on 2000+3000 (52 starts; champion code + passive sim log). Held-out set not measured.
closest_prior_test: None on reload timing. Nearest fire-handling tests: B15 aim lead + fire discipline LOSS (2.65 vs 2.98) and B7 drop the 100 m gun gate LOSS (2.04 vs 2.38); both changed when we shoot, P34 changes only when an idle gun refills. Not in the B125 package list (TAC_SPACE_EARLY, TAC_FIRE_MOVE, TAC_DODGE, TAC_JET_LOOT, TAC_LASER_REACH, TAC_FINISH_AMMO).
what_would_disprove: Paired screen: decisions with a clear enemy target while reloading not lower in fired games, or first-3-s damage dealt after re-contact lower, or deaths in the 10 s after an activation higher than the champion; fired < 10/192. The 52% 'target back within 2.4 s' share is the main way this loses.
risks: Pins: none (no movement). Drops: no movement, and gated on obs.drops empty. Combat: a reload started just before the target reappears delays the first shot by up to 2.4 s (52% of starts in the champion log); the reload makes a 60 m sound (protocol.md sound list). Lightning/laser holders keep their other weapon, so the cost is smaller for them.
